builds.branch: fix/audit-1028 at 9a71618: 1.12.1 plus the trust-base proposal summary change, which does not touch detection

method_notes: Clones are depth 1 with no origin remote, each at the commit named as clone_head.
Plain scans run from the bench directory with the clone passed as an absolute path; --trust-base runs from inside the clone against clone_head. No code from a clone is executed.
The builds are interleaved run by run, three runs each, median wall time.
Findings are compared keyed by rule, file, line, offset, severity, source and both fingerprints. No difference is explained away: a release that does not change detection should show none.

hand_checks.why_these_repositories: Yelp/detect-secrets and gitleaks/gitleaks at the commits the 1.12.0 record used, so the counts can be read against it; urllib3/urllib3 at its 1.12.0 commit as a third, ordinary codebase.
hand_checks.against_the_1.12.0_record: Plain-scan counts equal the 1.12.0 record's branch counts: detect-secrets 213 files, 73 findings, 38 blocking; gitleaks 450 files, 414 findings, 389 blocking; urllib3 170 files, 2 findings.
hand_checks.detection_code: git diff v1.12.0 v1.12.1 over packages/core/src/scanners, utils/placeholder.ts, utils/entropy.ts and utils/data-shape.ts is empty; 1.12.1 changed the pull-request file set and fingerprint keying for linked paths only.
hand_checks.false_positives: Every finding in detect-secrets and gitleaks sits in test data, test sources, a committed baseline or a rule config (detect-secrets test_data/ and tests/, .secrets.baseline; gitleaks detect/detect_test.go, cmd/generate/, config/gitleaks.toml): credential-shaped values these scanners exist to detect, correctly matched by shape and not live secrets. urllib3's two findings are the test server's private keys under dummyserver/certs, real key material for a local test server. A project would exclude all of these with ignore.paths; none is a new false positive, since all were present in 1.12.0.
hand_checks.false_negatives: None measured. These repositories hold no secret known to be missed, and the planted cases are not rerun here: they live in the 1.12.0 record, and the detection code they exercise did not change.
hand_checks.wall_time: Not a measurement. Plain-scan medians for the branch were 1.13 to 1.29 times 1.12.0's, but the load average was 21 to 34 on 8 cores for the whole run and individual runs swing by up to 1.9 times within one build (see wall_ms_runs). A quiet-machine rerun is needed before reading anything into it.
